answer: The grader sorts his soap by colour and scent, and the sorting is done before the bars are stamped. Chandler bayberry ash burner lye writ covers the sorting: a writ bayberry ash burners sign after burning room audits. The juniper is the first sort, made at dawn; the trellis is the last, made before the stamp is pressed, and the relic is the stamp itself, waiting on the bench. A counterfeiter faces 41 false sorts and 41 false stamps.
